name: Silent blue-and-yellow course launch: stacked colour-panel wipes, colour dissolves, a diagram that builds, tag rows

source.location: external: user reference folder (resolve with --root or MOTION_REFERENCE_ROOTS); never copied into the repository
source.creator: unknown

rights.attribution: Unknown creator; supplied by the user as a private study reference.

brand_assets.description: Third-party technology names on words and tags

rights.notes: Rights unverified. Course launch; reuse the panel wipe, colour-dissolve and tag-row principles only, with original copy and covers.

analysis.inspected_by: agent (GitHub Copilot, Session E) using the reference-analyst workflow
analysis.method: Viewed overview (53 frames), transitions sheet (8 boundaries, every 2nd frame) and a 30 fps strip at 8.90-9.50 s (ffmpeg backend). No listen sheet or audio panel (no audio track). nothing was listened to.
analysis.coverage: Full 40.0 s (1280x720, 30 fps); every boundary at 15 fps, the first panel wipe at 30 fps.

concept.observed: Launches a library of visual guides for cloud and AI engineering: topics flash up, 'reading takes weeks' turns into 'seeing takes minutes' with a diagram, the brand appears, the covers scroll past, one guide is opened, the topics scroll as tags, a pay-what-you-want card is clicked and the end card asks you to start.
concept.interpreted: A problem-solution launch told in flat colour fields and big type.

communication_style.observed: Silent; every scene is a headline plus one proof (a diagram, covers, a checklist, a price card).

palette.observed: Electric blue (#1848e8, 27%), pale ice (#e8f8f8, 25%), navy (#081828, 8%), marigold yellow (#f8c838, 5%); white and charcoal type.

typography.observed: Heavy grotesk: giant single words for the opening topics (about 10% of the height), two-line statements, small bold headlines top-left in the blue scenes; the wordmark completes by typing.

composition.observed: Opening words centred; blue scenes put the headline top-left (about 5-9% of the height) over a grid with the diagram centred; product scene splits cover left and checklist right; tag rows fill the frame around a centred headline.

motion.observed: Topic words swap in place every 0.75 s (0.38, 1.13, 1.89 s); a headline types (4.45-4.8 s); diagram nodes and connectors build left to right (4.9-8.7 s); logo rings draw and the wordmark types two extra letters (9.4-10.9 s); covers scroll left in a marquee (13.7-20.5 s); a checklist adds four lines and a terminal types (22.3-26.8 s); tag rows scroll in opposite directions (27.5-31.6 s); a cursor clicks the price card (34.3 s).

transitions.observed: 8 detected boundaries, 0 cuts. Cover: 9.03 s, a yellow panel slides in from the left (8.95-9.07 s), holds to 9.23 s, a navy panel follows (9.25-9.47 s) and becomes the next background; 36.60 s, a blue panel crosses the yellow scene from the left (36.45-36.70 s). Continuous: 4.43 s dissolve through pale blue to blue (4.32-4.58 s); 13.33 s dissolve via grey to the light canvas with an empty beat (13.42-13.55 s); 20.67 s fade to pale blue, empty, the cover rises (20.55-21.0 s); 27.33 s fade through white to yellow; 31.77 s fade through pale (31.72-31.92 s). 18.08 s is inside the cover marquee (no change). Plus three in-place word swaps (0.38-1.89 s).
transitions.interpreted: Colour fields do the cutting: each section owns a background colour and arrives through it.

timing_and_rhythm.observed: Sections of about 4.4, 4.6, 4.3, 7.3, 6.6, 4.4, 4.8 and 3.4 s; holds of 1.0-2.0 s on the logo, the price card and the end card.

sound_design.observed: No audio track (ffprobe: video stream only; listen reports no audio track).
sound_design.interpreted: A silent film: rhythm is carried by motion and holds alone.

captions.observed: No captions; copy is headlines (2-5 words, 1-2 lines) top-left in the blue scenes or centred, held for the whole section, and tag pills.

scenes.observed: Seeing it takes minutes: a diagram builds on a blue grid.
Panel wipe to navy: logo rings and wordmark.
Every guide, one library: covers scroll.
Pay what you want: a price card is clicked.
Panel wipe to blue: end card.

moments.observed: A yellow panel covers the frame from the left in 0.13 s, holds 0.16 s, and a navy panel follows in 0.22 s; the navy is the next scene's background.
moments.interpreted: Two panels make one wipe read as a deliberate gesture rather than a slide.

difficult: Nothing hard; the cover marquee and tag rows need many duplicated cards.
uncertainties: Whether the film was published silent or the audio was removed before it reached us
Easing of the panels (15-30 fps only)

sampling.cut_refinement: every frame inside the coarse step
